The apps download the channel schedule from rabbit-ears.stream and play videos straight from the Internet Archive. They remember your last channel on the TV itself and send nothing else to us. Your TV platform (Roku, Google or Amazon) may collect its own usage data under its own privacy policy.

The bundled English Whisper models recognize the channel audio ahead of playback. Existing stream subtitles are used first. Local recognition fills in only when a show has no usable subtitle track. Text follows the video timestamps, so pauses and seeks stay aligned. Playback keeps running while captions catch up. Built-in captions read the channel file directly, work with the player muted, and do not pick up other apps or a microphone. Audio and subtitles stay in memory and are not saved. Use Faster recognition on a slower computer. Words and estimated timings can still be imperfect.
